title: Leaked data shows more than 1,000 Russian military suicides during Ukraine war
summary_full: Exclusive: Figures from cache of 11m death certificates reveal suicides account for about a regiment of Russia’s war deadRussia’s war dead: the hidden toll of the Ukraine conflictIn late October 2024, Alexei Bolgov, a sergeant guarding a military headquarters in the occupied Donetsk region, told his wife, Natalya, over the phone: “It’s horrific, what’s going on here. I’ll tell you when I get back.”He never made it home. Five weeks later, shortly after turning 29, Bolgov walked about 300 metres from his unit’s command post near the village of Stepove into woodland and shot himself, according to a written account by his commander seen by the Guardian.
